parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The service address of the load balancing instance.

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The list of ENS node IDs.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the load balancing instance.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerName
parameters.description: The name of the load balancing instance.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerStatus
parameters.description:
The listener status of the load balancing instance. Valid values:
- **Active**: The listeners of the instance can forward received traffic based on rules.
- **InActive**: The listeners of the instance no longer forward received traffic.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerType
parameters.description: The type of the load balancing instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 10. Valid values: **10** to **100**.

parameters.name: ServerId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the backend server.
